info.title: RIP_Router
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

distance.description: The administrative distance associated with routes advertised by this RIP instance.

instance_tag.description:
Reference Resource: [RIP_Router](#/RIP_Router)
The list of all the RIPng (RIP IPv6) Router instances.

maximum_paths.description: Maximum number of equal cost paths that can be associated with a given  destination in the routing table corresponding to this instance.

protocol_timers.description: Timers related to this RIP instance.

garbage_collection.description: Duration in seconds until when routes will be retained in the  routing table after they have been marked as expired.

timeout.description: Duration in seconds until when routes learned from a  RIP neighbor are deemed active when there is no refresh  message from that neighbor. The routes are subsequently marked as expired.

update.description: Time interval in seconds between successive protocol  updates sent to RIP neighbors.

redistribute_ospf.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Router](#/OSPF_Router)
Allow redistribution of routes from one or more OSPF instances into this RIP instance.

redistribute_source.description: Allow redistribution of routes from other sources into this RIP instance.

rip_interfaces.description:
Reference Resource: [RIP_Interface](#/RIP_Interface)
RIP interfaces associated with this router instance. `ipv4`: List of IPv4 RIP_Interfaces with intf_key as prefix address in A.B.C.D format. `ipv6`: List of IPv6 RIP_Interfaces with intf_key as interface name.

global_queries.description: Number of RIP messages sent out in response to queries  received from other routers on this instance.

global_route_changes.description: Number of times that the IP routing table contents were  updated by this RIP instance. This does not include  updates to the IP route age information.

statistics_clear_performed.description: Number of times statistics for this RIP instance have been cleared.

statistics_clear_requested.description: Number of times a request was made to clear statistics for this RIP instance.

statistics_reset_time.description: Time in seconds since Epoch when statistics information for this RIP instance was last reset.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
